raw_response: {"diagnosis": "silver_transactions derives txn_date from CAST(ingest_ts AS DATE), but ingest_ts is always the next day at 02:00 (the batch load time), so txn_date never matches the transaction's own date. Every POSTED row (4582) fails DATE_CONSISTENCY, and the gold daily tables group on the wrong date. Deriving txn_date from txn_ts, as the monitor expects, fixes this, and the gold steps rebuild from silver.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
